summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the expiration of appraisal rights for holders of Class A1 and Class B1 preferred shares who dissented from the conversion of those shares into common shares as part of the company's migration to B3's Novo Mercado. Only one dissenting shareholder holding 20 PNB1 shares exercised appraisal rights, with a redemption value of R$ 40.6218599632 per share, totaling R$ 812.44. Management will not call a shareholder meeting to reconsider the conversion. Payment is expected on May 8, 2026. This is a post-closing procedural update, not a standalone special situation event.
